name: @bashbop/otito-herdr-plugin
description: Run Otito context and deterministic merge evidence inside Herdr agent workspaces.

scripts.check: node --check action.mjs && node --check runtime.mjs && node --check trust-pane.mjs
scripts.smoke: (git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || git init --quiet) && OTITO_REPO=. OTITO_REQUEST='Inspect this Herdr plugin' node action.mjs context
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run audit && npm run smoke
